context: A small group of children are play-acting a “Steel Watcher” checkpoint they can see below, with one child taking the guard role and the others lined up as citizens. Child 2 (Cinnamon) is thrilled to be under inspection but is secretly hiding candy in her pocket that the others haven't discovered. The dialogue is a mock interrogation—friendly banter where the “guard” asks if she’s suspicious and she replies evasively—while the narrator quietly reveals the hidden treat. This scene mirrors real village checkpoint interrogations (the cluster contexts), but here it’s innocent mimicry rather than an actual crime being investigated.
